scripts.aruna:doctor: pnpm --filter aruna build && pnpm --filter aruna aruna doctor --project .
scripts.aruna:doctor:fix: pnpm --filter aruna build && pnpm --filter aruna aruna doctor --fix --project .
scripts.aruna:check: pnpm --filter aruna build && pnpm --filter aruna aruna check --project .
scripts.aruna:build: pnpm --filter aruna build && pnpm --filter aruna aruna build --emit-runtime --project .
scripts.inspect:actions: pnpm --filter aruna build && pnpm --filter aruna aruna inspect actions --project .
scripts.inspect:contract: pnpm --filter aruna build && pnpm --filter aruna aruna inspect contract --project . --json
scripts.contract:diff: pnpm --filter aruna build && pnpm --filter aruna aruna contract diff --project . --baseline src/.aruna/contract.snapshot.json
